messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Testing additions to stan/src/stan/lang/function_signatures.h
parts:
I just added the sparse matrix functions to the function_signatures file on my stan-dev/stan branch. The functions are already in stan-dev/math and they have tests there. A few questions:

- Do I need to write tests to check that my functions from stan-dev/math are exposed correctly?

- If so, how do I write tests (short of just compiling and running a model by hand) to check that my functions are exposed correctly? I don't understand the entire testing framework in stan-dev/stan so it's hard to tell without some more guidance.

- Are there any other tasks in stan-dev/stan besides modifying function_signature.h and testing? I feel like I'm missing something but maybe having the split repos just makes it really easy...

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Testing additions to stan/src/stan/lang/function_signatures.h
parts:
> On Aug 31, 2015, at 10:14 AM, Krzysztof Sakrejda <krzysztof...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> I just added the sparse matrix functions to the function_signatures file on my stan-dev/stan branch. The functions are already in stan-dev/math and they have tests there. A few questions:
>
> - Do I need to write tests to check that my functions from stan-dev/math are exposed correctly?
Yes.

> - If so, how do I write tests (short of just compiling and running a model by hand) to check that my functions are exposed correctly? I don't understand the entire testing framework in stan-dev/stan so it's hard to tell without some more guidance.

You want to put models with all the possible var/double/int instantiations
in test/test-models/good

You'll see examples for the other signatures. This is enough to make
sure they compile and are exposed correctly. The tests that they do the right
thing should go in math.
> - Are there any other tasks in stan-dev/stan besides modifying function_signature.h and testing? I feel like I'm missing something but maybe having the split repos just makes it really easy...

Doc. I can do that if you'd rather.

- Bob

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Testing additions to stan/src/stan/lang/function_signatures.h
parts:
./runTests.py src/test/integration/compile_models_test.cpp

That'll kick off all the models.

If you want to run just a single one and it's at src/test/test-models/good/foo.stan, you can run:
make src/test/test-models/good/foo.hpp-test

(yes, that's make, not the python script)
